title: Construct pseudotrigonal superlattice
action: From the monoclinic lattice parameters (a, b, c, β), compute the pseudotrigonal basis vectors V₁ = T₃+T₁, V₂ = T₁−T₂, V₃ = T₁+T₂. Identify the pseudo‑binary axes [011] and [01\bar{1}] and the pseudo‑mirror planes (11\bar{3}) and (1\bar{1}3).
description: Builds the pseudosymmetry model from which all domain and wall characteristics are derived. The agent should output a JSON summarising the vectors and identified pseudosymmetry elements for documentation.

title: Compute W' and W wall angles and verify tanθ = –c/a
action: Using the pseudotrigonal lattice and the monoclinic metric, compute the W'‑wall characteristics: angle ψ between [010] and [011], the angle 2ψ between twofold axes; construct the rhombic section to obtain wall tilt angle θ and tanθ; independently compute spontaneous strain components a and c and −c/a, and verify equality. Also compute the W‑wall twinning by pseudomirror (11\bar{3}): determine the dihedral angle between the (100) planes of adjacent domains (gutter angle) and the angle between their monoclinic twofold axes. Include all computed quantities in the JSON output.
description: Central scored artifact containing the main numerical predictions for both W' and W walls, the strain components, and the strain–geometry relation check.
